name: Gin
source:
The protagonist. A traveling magician, unemployed and looking for a job. But upon protecting a group of merchants from bandits, he gets a store deed as a reward. Thus begins Gin's new life as a store owner.

He opens a shop in a land ridden by monsters, hoping to monopolize the adventures. To make his shop prosperous, he'll have to enlist help from various people that he comes across.

He's Arute husband. Curiously he has permission from his wife (Arute) to have sex with other women.
